(hūm̐ dang*/mkhyen brtse bka' 'bum ca nang*/)༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'khrid kyi 'chad thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan ces bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐ dang*/ mkhyen brtse bka' 'bum ca nang*/)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'khrid kyi 'chad thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī pā dā ya/ e dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// waṃ yig bde chen thig ler byang chub pa// zung 'jug dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gnas su dbugs 'byin mdzod// de la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i 'khrid kyi rim pa ji ltar 'chad pa la/ spyir slob dpon gyi mkhyen rtogs che chung*/ slob ma'i dbang po rno rtul yul dus gnas skabs dang bcas pa'i dbang gis mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang*/ rgyas par nyin grangs nyer lngar 'chad pa'i tshul ni 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab sa chen thugs thig las shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir shin tu bsdus pa nyin bdun gyi khongs su bskyed rdzogs kyi dngos gzhi zhal shes dang bcas pa tshang bar ston pa'i tshul la/ thog mar slob ma rab bde mchog lū nag gam/ de min dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa la/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu gang yang rung bar/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil dang*/ mtshams sbyor ji ltar rigs pa sbyar la 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin par byas nas/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku yod na dgram pa'i spyan sngar stegs kyi khar mkha' spyod ma'i 'bul gtor dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor zlum po'i bar du dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma ste gtor ma gsum mam/ bsdu na/ zlum gtor gcig gang ltar yang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bsham/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug slob dpon gyi mdun du 'thor nas/ ḍā ma ru/ rdor dril/

nang mchod/ las kyi rdo rje'i drung du maṇ+ḍal 'bru dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa 'du bya/ de nas rang nyid kyis de ring slob ma la 'bogs rgyu'i dmigs thun nyid gtso bor bton pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas bkra shis kyi bar grub rjes/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag dang yon phul/ rigs dang yon tan rgan pa bslab pa sogs kyi gral rim la 'khod grub pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ dpon slob kun gyis 'ur 'don byas la he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig brjod/ mthar thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bdag ni sogs bshags sdom gyi tshig gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/ slob dpon nam gzhan gang rung gis bskul la/ brgyud 'debs lam rim gnad bskul rnams tshar chen gyis mdzad pa bzhin/ byung na brgyud 'debs la tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung gdangs yod pa bzhin gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len la'ang mdzad gsungs pas de bzhin bya/ lam rim tshugs pa dang las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal gyi 'bru bkye bsdu byas rjes/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma gang gi mchod rdzas ma bcas bgyid skabs/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang*/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin brlab/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub thabs kyi gsham nas 'byung ba ltar mkha' spyod mar gtor ma dbul/ yang gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs la dur khrod bdag po'i gtor sngags lan gsum/ phyi nang gi mchod bstod phrin las gzhol/ yang gong bzhin byin brlabs la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams byas pa'i mthar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol/ gtor mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med pa rnams/ lag pa rgyab sbyar mtheb srin gyi se gol dang*/

badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ 'chi tshe mgon sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ zhwa yod na gyon/ lus kyi 'dug stangs drang por gnas pas/ zang zing med pa'i snying rje dang 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod gyi blo yi dam gyi nga rgyal rnams gsal btab nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ nyin dang po la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang rin po che de ci nas kyang thob nges par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa rnam par dag pas/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang lus kyi 'dug stangs drangs por gnas pa dang*/ sems kyi dmigs par gnas khang 'di nyid kyang tha mal gyi snang ba tsam ma yin par dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ da ltar chos ston mkhan gyi slob dpon kyang tha mal gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu ma yin par/ seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags stong skye ba med pa'i ngang du lhang lhang sgrogs pa srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel bar byed pa dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyang thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pa'i sgo nas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang nas yengs med kyi tshul du gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam nas thugs kyi dga' ba yin no// bzhi pa tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor ni nas/

de ltar bya gsungs so bar/ gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro nas/ gsum nges par brjod do bar rnams 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i khrid yig mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam ltar bshad/ gsum pa sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/ zhes mtshams sbyar te bde kye gang rung gi rnam bshad kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar bshad rjes/ 'di'i skabs su spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' che chung rang gi mtho tshad tsam du bsgom pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros yin gsungs/ zhes brjod/ thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub nas brtsams te rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug rlung rngam pa can rang zhir ma song gi bar du cung zad tsam ngal bso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su len pa la/ gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum mam/ shin tu tha ma skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub thob pa nas bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros yin gsungs bar gong bzhin tshar gcig slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir nas/ yin gsungs bar lan gsum bshad mthar/ de lta bu'i nyams len gyi rim pa de rnams kyang*/ sngon nas nyams len byed bzhin pa yin na/ thun las ldang bar brtsams pa na bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs shar sgom gyis nyams su blangs la smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya/ de nas bzung nyams len byed pa yin na/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi rjes su de lta bu las byung ba'i dge ba rnams gzhan don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab nas thun las ldang ba dang*/

thun mtshams thams cad du'ang sgo gsum dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya dgos pas do nub kyi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob mas phyag phul nas rang gnas su phyin/ de nas bzung khrid ma grol bar la thun bzhir chags med byed/ 'di pa'i lugs la mthong grol sde mig tu gsungs pa ltar byin brlabs thob nas rgyun khyer dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i dam bca' chag med du bzla dgos pas/ gong du rnam bzhag gnyis bshad pa de ni spyir btang tsam mo//

des na slob ma thams cad rgyun khyer chag med du byed pa yin na/ gsum bshad kyi mthar/ thun las ldang ba nas bkra shis kyi bar bya/ zhes pa'i mthar/ thun mtshams thams cad sogs gong ltar sbrel lo/ mchan/ ༈ /nyin gnyis pa la/ 'o nam mkha' nas/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros yin gsungs bar kha sang gi bshad pa dang po ltar bskyar la/ de yan chad kha sang gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa yang bskyar gyi tshul du phul ba yin/ da de ring thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du phul ba la'ang*/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ dpyad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su blang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni nas/ sbyong byed ye shes tshogs bsags 'dis lam du byed pa yin no gsung bar khrid yig ltar/ gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa la/ bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs myur du rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba ste/ de sgom pa'i tshul ni/ gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum// zhes 'byung ba'i zhal shes dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bskyed pa dang*/ zhal shes gnyis pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes dag nyams su blang bar bya ba yin te/ de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du song nas/ tha mal gyi snang ba dbyings su thim pa'i nas/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi rnams mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du blo bzhag nas/ khrid kyi skabs 'dir ku sā li'i tshogs gsog lan mang gi mthar/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma grangs ci mang lag len ltar dbul/ skabs su so bdun ma'ang spro na byed gsungs/ de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas nas/ lam me'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag go bar rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung ltar la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong sogs sbyar/ thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir nas/

'jug par bya ste bar kha sang ltar/ de la'ang bsgom bya'i don la nas/ mnyam par bzhag go bar gong bzhin/ slar yang thugs nges par nas/ mnyam par bzhag go /thun de las ldang bar 'dod na/ mngon rtogs kyi 'phro rnams dkyus bzhin nyams su blang ba'am/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su de lta bu las byung ba'i sogs kha sang ltar ro// ༈ /nyin gsum pa la/ 'o nam mkha' nas/ dpyad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis kyi bar nyin dang po ltar/ dang po las/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor/ tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ gnyis pa las/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang bcas pa'i khrid rnams legs par phul zin nas/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni nas/ lam me'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag go bar khar sang ltar bskyar la/ de yan chad kha sang gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa yang bskyar gyi tshul du phul ba yin/ da de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du phul ba la'ang*/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ dpyad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su blang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni nas/ bol gnyis su bsgom pa'o bar khrid yig ltar/ gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa la/ 'jug pa'i rim pa/ gnas pa'i rim pa/ ldang ba'i rim pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan dkyus bzhin du nyams su blang*/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i nyams len de ka'i ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas rang gi snying gar e e las nas/ bam̐ yig la thim par bsam mo bar tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs nas 'byung ba ltar bshad pa'i mthar/ de lta bu'i bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu brtson pa dang*/

khyad par rtsa sngags oṃ gsum ma dam bca' bzhin chags med du bzlas pas/ re zhig nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mngon sum du rjes su 'dzin par bshad pa ni gang zag rab bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin pas khyed rang rnams kyis kyang byin rlabs thob nas bzung bsgom bzlas chag med du nyams su len pa shin tu gal che ba lags/ gnyis pa gnas pa'i rim pa la/ dpyad don dngos byed pa can gyi bskyed rim sems 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams 'byung ba ste/ de la'ang nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa/ bye brag la sems 'dzin pa/ lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa dang bzhir yod pa las/ dang po nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa ni/ ji skad du/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba// bskyed pa'i rim pa gnad du che// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya ba can gyi bskyed rim 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams shar bsgom gyi tshul du nyams su blangs shing*/ zhar byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pa legs par bsgom pa'i mthar 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin/ skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun rdzogs 'bras dus bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de dngos yin snyam du nga rgyal bskyed la hril gyis bsgrim/ tha mal gyi dngos po 'gags pa tsam byung na a 'thas mi bya bar mdun gyi dngos po gang rung zhig gi steng du sems spos la lhod kyis glod la bzhag yang 'og 'gyu skyes na nga rgyal la hril gyis bsgrim/ de ltar byas kyang rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal mi 'char bar tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa kho nar shar kyang u tshugs mi bya bar rim gyis bslab/ gnyis pa rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa ni/ 'o na nga nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin na/ de'i rnam pa ji lta bu zhe na/ de yang sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku'i rnam pa spyi tsam la yid zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad des sems 'dzin/

gsum pa rnam pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa la'ang*/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas spyan dbus ma nas/ rgyan med pa la sems 'dzin par khrid yig ltar la/ de rnams kyang dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ gnas byung ba dang gzhan la spo ba sogs sngar ji skad bshad pa bzhin byas la/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing reg mthong gi mtshan ma brtan po ma skyes kyi bar du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa rnams thun chung la grangs mang ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs pa'i mthar thun mong ba'i bsam mi khyab sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya'o gsungs/ thugs nges par bya ba'i nas/ 'jug par bya ste bar nyin dang po ltar/ de la'ang bsgom bya'i don la nas/ bya'o gsungs bar gong ltar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i nas/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya dgos pas de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs// ༈ /nyin bzhi pa la/ 'o nam mkha' nas/ dpyad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis kyi zhes pa'i bar nyin dang po ltar la/ dang po las/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor/ tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ gnyis pa las/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i khrid rnams legs par phul zin nas/ drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa'i nas tshul bzhin du bya'o gsungs bar khar sang ltar bskyar/ de yan chad khar sang gi nas/ nyams su blang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ snying gi dkyil du 'chang ba gal che'o gsungs so bar khrid yig ltar/

gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa la 'jug gnas ldang gsum las/ dang po 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gyi bar mngon rtogs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gsal la drag par shar bsgom gyi tshul gyis gsal btab/ gnyis pa gnas pa'i rim pa sems 'dzin dngos la/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa yan sngon du song zin nas/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa ni/ dpral bar ye shes kyi nas/ mtshan ma thob kyi bar nyams su blang bar bya'o bar khrid yig ltar/ thugs nges par nas 'jug par bya ste bar nyin dang po ltar/ de la'ang bsgom bya'i don la nas/ nyams su blang bar bya'o bar dang*/ slar yang thugs nges par nas/ nyams su blang bar bya'o bar gong ltar bskyar/ de nas tshogs pa byings grol nas/ slob ma gsum re la lus dkyil thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rim bzhin du bshad par bya ste/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lus dkyil snyan brgyud nyams su len pa'i tshul la'ang*/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang*/ dpyad don nyams su blang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba dag pa'i nas/ sngags phreng sogs bsgom bar tshar chen rin po che'i gsung lus dkyil snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu ltar la/ yang na/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal btab/ de nas go cha bgod pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya bar gsungs te/ de ltar gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su phyi ma ltar mdzad pa lags/ gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba la/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo nas 'khor gyi bar re re la'ang spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar rim bzhin du sems 'dzin pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba'i tshul sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o// thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas/

nyams su blang bar bya'o bar/ thugs nges par nas/ nyams su blang bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par nas/ nyams su blang bar bya'o bar bzhi bshad kyi mthar/ de lta bu'i lus dkyil snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa 'di'i zab gnad/ rdo rje'i lus la nas/ ming tsam yang mi grags par bya'o bar tshar chen rin po che'i gsung ltar lan gcig brjod/ thams cad la 'khrid grub bstun/ slar mnyam du tshogs pa la/ gsum pa ldang ba'i rim pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na/ khrid yig las mngon rtogs dkyus ma las 'byung nas/ rnams kyi nges par bya gsungs te de ltar na de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs// ༈ /nyin lnga pa la/ 'o nam mkha' nas/ dpyad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis kyi bar nyin dang po ltar/ dang po las/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor/ tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bdag lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ gnyis pa las/ sngon 'gro rnam pa bzhi dang*/ dngos gzhi rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa yan chad kyi khrid rnams legs par phul zin nas/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las nas/ mtshan ma thob kyi bar du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa ldang ba'i rim pa ni nas/ nges par bya gsungs te bar kha sang ltar bskyar la/ de dag ni rten bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o// de yan chad kha sang gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa yang bskyar gyi tshul du phul ba yin/ da de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba ni/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim pa ni nas/ ye shes su 'char ba zhig yong la bar khrid yig ltar/ de nas spyod pa dang nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar bas/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so// thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/

gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ rje btsun yum gyi ngo bo ti la ka nas/ 'gyur bar gsungs so bar/ slar yang thugs nges par nas/ gsungs so bar/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha skur gsal ba la go cha dgod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab/ thun mtshams rnams su snang grags rtog gsum dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas spyod lam dge ba'i rtsa bas dus 'da' bar bya ste/ de ltar na de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs// ༈ /nyin drug pa la/ 'o nam mkha' nas/ smon lam gyi lam dang bzhir yod kyang zhes pa'i bar nyin dang po bzhin la/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi nyams len ni bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang*/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma gnyis su 'du ba las/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i khrid rnams legs par phul zin nas/ gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' nas/ 'gyur bar gsungs so bar kha sang ltar/ de yan chad kha sang gi dmigs pa yang bskyar gyi tshul du phul ba yin la/ da de ring gi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la nas/ dbyings rig bsre'o bar tshar chen rin po che'i gsung rab ltar/ thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ rje btsun nā ro nas/ bsre'o bar/ thugs nges par nas/ bsre'o bar/ slar yang thugs nges par nas/ bsre'o bar lan bzhir bskyar la/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod na/ rang nyid thun mtshams sogs khar sang ltar ro// ༈ /nyin bdun pa la/ maṇ+ḍal yan grub nas tshogs pa byings grol/ de nas slob ma re re bzhin bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid tshar chen rin po che'i gsung rab ltar bzhi bshad kyi tshul du 'chad par bya ste/

de'ang sems bskyed gsal 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon tu 'gro bas/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa gsang ba mtha'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ skabs dang bstun par bya'o bar/ thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub nas brtsams te nas/ 'jug par bya ste/ de yang rgyas par na nas/ skabs dang bstun par bya'o bar/ thugs nges par nas/ skabs dang bstun par bya'o bar slar yang thugs nges par nas/ skabs dang bstun par bya'o// thun de las ldang bar 'dod na/ bsam mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang las rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal btab nas go cha dgod/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ spyod lam rnams su'ang dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de lta bu'i gdams pa 'di la chig bsgril du nas/ rje bla ma'i gsungs las thos so bar brjod do// thams cad la 'khrid dmigs 'bogs tshar nas slar lhan cig tu tshogs pa la/ de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rim gnyis zab mo la rtse gcig tu bslab pas/ cir snang thams cad lha dang bde chen gyi ye shes su 'char ba'i nyams myong khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa na/ de nas thogs mar gsang spyod nas/ tshul bzhin du bya'o bar khrid yig ltar/ thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ de ltar rje btsun nas tshul bzhin du bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par nas/ tshul bzhin du bya'o bar/ de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo cha tshang du thob pa yin pas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma dbul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i nying khu grub pa mchog gi slob dpon dpal nā ro ta pa la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba nas bzung*/ snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i nye lam dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid bka' zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas rang rang gis nyams su len pa dang*/ snod min la bab col du mi ston cing*/ snod ldan la bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du ston pa sogs rang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas pa mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs chos bsngo gang shes bya'o// bsngo ba rgyas par byed na/ rang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa dang*/ de ltar rang re rnams kyis chos 'chad nyan byas pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams byang chub snying por bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam la sogs pa'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la spyi bsngo dang*/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/ shis brjod bcas rgyas par bya'o// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i smin grol gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di 'chad pa la nye bar mkho ba'i yig cha'i skor la/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub dkyil/ byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor gang rigs 'jam mgon mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam/ bde kye gang rung gi rnam bshad las 'byung ba'i rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi zhal shes/

tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i lus dkyil snyan brgyud/ rje btsun yab yum gyi 'pho ba/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang*/ 'chad thabs 'di nyid bcas kyis don grub par yod la/ bsnyen sgrub dang rgyun gyi nyams len sogs la gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg rmor chen gyi bsnyen thabs rnams lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa nyid do// legs gsung mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam gyi// 'chad thabs nor bu'i chun 'phyang rab g.yo ba// chos smra mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur te// phan bde'i 'dod rgu rtag tu 'jo bar shog /ces pa'ang chos rje bla ma dam pa ā nan+da mañdzu gho ṣas snga phyir yang yang bskul ba ltar/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 'chad thabs la gzhi byas/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po las ji ltar thob pa'i tshul dang mthun par/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas gti thug nag 'gros su bris pa la mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ 'dis kyang lam zab mo'i bshad sgrub bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ban tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
